fields.description: Standard Rows: one header row names every column, one row per order line (the existing behavior). Wide Matrix: several orders laid out as side-by-side column groups under a multi-row header (e.g. a colour/date/PO row per group) - see the Wide Matrix Layout section below.
fields.label: Layout Type

fields.description: Which row of the file holds the column headers.
fields.label: Header Row

fields.description: Column that separates one physical order from another when a single file contains several orders (e.g. "Order No", "PO Number"). Leave blank if one file is always one order.
fields.label: Multi-Order Split Column

fields.description: Set only when this platform is shared by more than one Customer (e.g. a buyer code column where different values are actually different customers). Which real Customer each value means is held per Customer Order Mapping row (its Differentiator Value). Leave blank when this platform belongs to one customer.
fields.label: Customer Differentiator Column

fields.description: 0-indexed row holding each column-group's label (e.g. a colour name).
fields.label: Group Label Row

fields.description: 0-indexed row holding each group's order date.
fields.label: Order Date Row

fields.description: 0-indexed row holding each group's delivery date.
fields.label: Delivery Date Row

fields.description: 0-indexed row holding each group's PO number (the pair's first column).
fields.label: PO Number Row

fields.description: 0-indexed column of the item's own code (informational only - matching uses Description, not this).
fields.label: Item Code Column

fields.description: 0-indexed column of the item's description - this is the text matched against a Specification.
fields.label: Description Column

fields.description: 0-indexed column of the item's stems-per-bunch rate (cross-checked against the resolved Specification, not load-bearing).
fields.label: Bunch Rate Column

fields.description: 0-indexed column where the first group's ordered-quantity column starts.
fields.label: First Group Column

fields.description: Columns per group (e.g. 2 for an ordered/confirmed pair).
fields.label: Group Column Width

fields.description: Text in the Item Code Column that marks the end of item rows.
fields.label: Stop Value

fields.description: The column layout most customers on this platform use. A Customer Order Mapping can override or add to this per customer.
fields.label: Default Field Mappings
